Bihar Youth Congress Clash : patna men bihar yuth kangres ke ek karyakram ke dauran bhari hangama dekhne ko mila... navnirvachit pradesh adhyaksh bittu raj ke bayan ke bad adhyaksh aur upadhyaksh ke samarthak aamne-samne aa gae... bataya ja raha hai ki sansad pappu yadav par ki gaee tippani se pradesh upadhyaksh manish yadav aur unke samarthak naraj ho gae, jiske bad karyakram men vivad barh gaya
